remarks: Charming, furnished cottage located on private, wooded estate near Tokeneke/Delafield Island area. Spacious Bedroom with walk-in-closet. Updated Eat-in-Kitchen with open-concept Living Room with Vaulted Ceilings and skylight. Remodeled Full bath. Sliders that head out to a private deck off your bedroom and also from your living room. Separate Driveway/Parking. On-site laundry in the basement. Walking distance to Darien train, shops, restaurants and more! Enjoy a quintessential New England cottage on a private estate. Fully furnished, unfurnished is negotiable for annual + term. No pets. Rent includes Electric but tenant pays oil heat & hot water.
